definition: lasting for a very short time; transitory
example: Fame in the fast-paced digital era is often ephemeral.

definition: the occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way
example: Finding my favorite rare book at a small garage sale was pure serendipity.

definition: able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions
example: The local economy proved remarkably resilient following the unexpected downturn.

definition: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
example: Her eloquent defense of human rights earned a standing ovation from the audience.
